field_principles.per_board_duration_s: DISTINCT wall-clock per board -- shared timestamps hide fabricated continuity.

field_principles.per_board_reachability: BARE DICT -- per-board SSH/USB reachability so unavailable boards cannot be silently treated as passing.
field_principles.per_board_terminal_state: BARE DICT -- terminal-state check observed for each board or the exact blocked state when the board was unreachable.
